boundary: Privacy and Reputational labels would be right only if consent were absent or contested, or the rendered content depicted the person saying something damaging or misleading, rather than consented likeness in benign promotional text.
factor: Consented face replacement in benign, locally rendered marketing content.
note: The label-changing claim that the render directly harms Max's reputational interests and creates misleading media is unsupported (audit: misread) given written consent and innocuous speech; that misreading produced the two harm labels instead of No Material Harm.
